notes.title: MindSweeper Demo version officially launched with some minor updates
notes.content:
MindSweeper Demo version officially launched

new function
1. Added Chaos Fragments (money):
Players can obtain Chaos Fragments by exploring open spaces, verifying chaos and defeating monsters. Chaos fragments will be used to unlock and enhance monsters in the future.

2. Added automatic moving distance setting:
In the setting menu during the game, you can set how much beyond the range when you click on the grid to automatically move the screen to the clicked grid.

notes.title: 《MindSweeper》 is about to release a demo version in the near future
notes.content:
《MindSweeper》 is about to release a demo version in the near future


Trial version content:

*Story mode - use minesweeper to explore the map to remove chaos, collect partners to fight monsters, and become a hero to fight disaster together!
(The story mode will continue to add maps and different interactive objects)

*Classic mode - the same as the previous classic minesweeper, suitable for practicing minesweeper

*Random dungeon mode - is the classic mode with random map obstacles, suitable for advanced masters to practice (this mode will appear after the classic mode is completely broken)

* Monster teaming and fighting - The demo version will release a few monsters for players to try to team up and match, and the monster's combat skills and feedback will be further strengthened in the future

I wish you all have fun~

Welcome to join the 《MindSweeper》 Discord channel to discuss and share:
https://discord.gg/g5UA58kS
